messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Third protocol. The creature now projects fragments of your military operation. They are not exact memories, more like emotions it is rebuilding.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: It shows you a dark room, a broken radio order, and a silhouette waiting near the egg.

choices.label: I cut the vision off before it exploits my memories.
I record every detail as evidence to analyze.
I let it feel my fear so I can understand what it wants.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The vision changes with your reaction. It is not archiving your past: it is trying to build a language from what marked you.

choices.label: I turn the vision into a usable mental map.
I use it as a warning and prepare a response.
I look for the central emotion instead of the military detail.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: If this memory becomes part of its genome, you need to choose what it should inherit from you.

choices.label: A clear order: survive and protect the perimeter.
An open question: search for the signal's origin.
A stable presence: do not panic when the bond shakes.
